adapter_provenance.method: Independent dispositions and dimension rationales copied unchanged; source paths bound to evidence IDs

reliability.rationale: All saved predictions and primary metrics independently reproduce from source-verified inputs, including unfavorable alternatives. Finite-pulse diffusion scaling improves primary voltage MAE in96 held rest blocks within one cell, but its RMSE and worst-group error lose to the flexible model. The first120s calibration is explicit; diffusivity and equilibrium voltage are not uniquely identified.
